answer: Honest actors reach the reputation zenith cheaply, while a sable-hat attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund every bond from scratch, and slashing burns those bonds on any proven duplicate, making mass forgery cost more than it returns. Sybil resistance here relies on a stake-weighted inlet gate: each reputation slot must lock a bond that scales with its claimed reputation, and rewards flow through a single verified payout channel per agent. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
